title: Unplayable pitches draw nothing — and say so in red
description: Two half notes no guitar can play: a bare C2 (below every open string) and a C3 annotated onto string 1 (below that string's open E4). Neither gets a fret digit — there is no silent clamp — and each raises a red scope:'tab' validation badge on the bar. The notation staff engraves both notes perfectly; only the tab staff reports, because the constraint is the fingerboard's, not the music's.
